onDeviceInput.title: On-device voice input
onDeviceInput.description: Prefer local speech recognition and avoid cloud fallback when possible.

autoPlay.title: Auto-play assistant replies
autoPlay.description: Read the latest assistant response aloud when it finishes.

workingSound.title: Working sound
workingSound.description: Play a calm loop while the assistant is still working on a reply.

resumeListening.title: Resume listening after reply
resumeListening.description: In conversation mode, start listening again after spoken playback ends.

speechLocale.label: Speech locale
speechLocale.helper: Leave empty to use the system default language for voice input and playback.

brief.label: Brief
brief.description: Short, tightly scoped answers for natural back-and-forth.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Concise answers with a little more context when helpful.

detailed.label: Detailed
detailed.description: Longer explanations and more supporting detail.

nextActions.title: Simple next actions
nextActions.description: End replies with a short recommendation when there is a clear next move.

soft.label: Soft chime
soft.description: Warm layered tone with a gentle pulse.

voice.footer: Android can periodically check running sessions in the background and post a completion notification. Background speech and continuous microphone capture are not supported.
